'''Skerrick Das''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]. On one occasion, Das was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and he sought passage aboard the [[Dartiss-5 Caravel]] ''[[Lost Lady]]'' to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where he planned to rejoin his [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
